card.name: Severe before disease or risk terms
card.fires_on: The word "severe" (or its start, "Se|vere") after phrases like "vulnerable to" or "increased risk of", before a disease or complication. It also fires on a few other partway-through-word spots, such as COVID-19 or influenza.

modes.label: Severe after risk phrases
modes.description: "severe" or "severity" following wording about increased risk or vulnerability.
modes.example: are at increased risk of<< severe>> bone marrow suppression.

modes.label: Split disease names
modes.description: Partway through a disease or drug-class name, such as COVID-19 or influenza.
